thread:
Marco: Quick update — Marseille region cutover moved to tomorrow morning, canary start planned. Need final ownership clarifications + routing policy signoff. TL;DR: proxy config applied in staging, KMS keys provisioned, peering pending and a small autoscale quirk noticed in staging.
Priya: Thanks Marco. Can you confirm data residency parity with NL2? Legal already looked?
Anya (Legal): Quick note: residency controls look good from our side. We need the final encryption config and IAM list for the KMS keys to close the compliance checklist.
Chen: From routing side — current default egress points at eu-west-3. We need an explicit prefer-local policy for inference services with a clear fallback chain. Who owns the service list?
Sofia: Services that must prefer local: inference-runtime, kv-cache, metrics-exporter. All others can failover to eu-west-3. I'll paste the intended rule in a sec.
Jordan: Infra side: PR #3421 (marseille-bgp-and-proxy) is ready for canary deployment. Need eng-platform review + BGP policy signoff. Pinging @Chen @Sofia for review.
Marco: Can @Chen @Sofia review PR by EOD? Also we measured KV cold-start penalty ~150ms in staging — need to decide if we accept it or pre-warm.
Chen: Reviewing now. Draft routing rule looks like: 
```yaml
- match: host: inference.redwood.marseille.*
  action: prefer_local
  fallbacks:
    - region: eu-west-3
    - region: eu-west-1
```
Priya: Product asks to keep canary at 5% for 2 hours, then 20% for 4 hours before full rollout. Can ops support that cadence?
Jordan: Yes — autoscale and canary scheduling can mirror NL2. I can queue the canary at the requested times.
Sofia: KMS key names in prod are "redwood-mrsl-enc-1". Need KMS IAM to include infra-canary and runtime-prod service accounts. @Anya (Legal) please confirm logging/retention requirements.
Anya (Legal): IAM ok as long as key usage is logged and retention policy is declared. Add the retention policy ARN to the runbook and we're good.
eng-oncall-bot: Deploy started by @Jordan at 08:58 UTC — job id dj-7712. Watch logs: https://deploys/redwood/dj-7712
Marco: Preflight checklist I'm watching: DNS TTL lower, KMS, routing, canary config, smoke tests. Anything missing?
Chen: FYI: autoscaling test flaked once in staging (tracked in issue https://issues/1234). PR #3430 is a hotfix. Recommend a 30m buffer before canary to merge and validate.
Priya: 30m buffer is fine. Move canary start to 09:30 UTC.
Jordan: Noted — scheduling canary at 09:30, 5% for 2h then ramp. I'll post the live metrics.
Sofia: Also adding egress ACLs for a small set of partner IPs (latency-sensitive partners). Pushed rules to infra ACL, will notify once propagated.
Marco: Final request — code review reminders: @Chen @Jordan @Sofia please review PRs #3421 & #3430 before 09:00 UTC. Appreciate it :pray:
Chen: Reviewed #3430, LGTM. Merging now.
Jordan: Reviewing #3421, leaving one minor comment on BGP communities.
Sofia: LGTM on the routing snippet, added one nit about healthcheck path.
eng-oncall-bot: Deploy success for step "provision-network" at 09:12 UTC. job dj-7712 step 3/7.
Marco: Great progress — keep posting updates in this thread. I'll capture canary telemetry and share a short post-canaRy summary after the 4h observation window. :rocket:
